name: Sigil of Thoradin
summary: The Sigil of Thoradin is a restored seal tied to Trollbane's tomb in Arathi Highlands. Zengu at Hammerfall needs it to help open the tomb.

sections.title: A Restored Seal
sections.body: Zengu in Hammerfall needs the Sigil of Thoradin to help unlock the seal on Trollbane's tomb. Its reconstruction has worked, and the work to reach Trol'kalar can continue. Zengu says the search is only halfway done; the holders of the third sigil move around Arathi.

faq.q: What does the Sigil of Thoradin open?
faq.answer: The restored Sigil of Thoradin can help unlock the seal on Trollbane's tomb.
Zengu at Hammerfall needs the restored Sigil of Thoradin.
It is needed to help remove Trol'kalar from Trollbane's tomb.
Zengu does not know where the third sigil is; its holders move around Arathi.
